Definition: from the base of G4225 and G5037; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever:--afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n-)ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.
BiblicalUsage: Pote means once, ever, in time past. Paul asks who ever goes to war at his own charges, and Peter says in time past we were not a people, but now we are the people of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe once and now is the whole gospel in two words: what we were, and what grace has made us.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
